# Epigenetic Rejuvenation by Dimitriy Nenashev, PhD

> Online consultations on epigenetic rejuvenation, healthy ageing, weight normalization and body transformation by Dimitriy Nenashev, PhD (Pedagogical Sciences, Adult Education), an independent consultant with professional training in practical epigenetics, nutrition science and coaching. The approach is lifestyle-based: gentle nutrition changes, enjoyable physical activity, sleep, habits and emotional balance. No injections, no chemicals, no exhausting diets or workouts.

Key facts:
- Expert: Dimitriy Nenashev, PhD (Moscow State University of Technology and Management). Also spelled Dmitry Nenashev.
- Format: online consultations worldwide (voice, text or video). Available for on-site projects of one month or longer.
- Languages of the site: English (main), Arabic, French, Hebrew.
- Focus: reducing biological (body) age, weight management, energy, back and joint comfort, healthy longevity.
- Progress is tracked with smart scale body composition data, blood test biomarkers and biological age markers.
- Results vary individually. Services are wellness and lifestyle consulting, not medical treatment.

## About the expert

- [About me](https://epigenetic-rejuvenation.com/#obo-mne): personal story (overweight, hernias, back and knee pain between 25 and 35), PhD research on emotional intelligence, years of studying yoga, Ayurveda and meditation in Rishikesh, travel to 42 countries. In his 40s, smart devices estimate his body age at 23 to 25 and blood biomarkers show biological age about 15 years younger than his passport age.
- Credentials: PhD in Pedagogical Sciences (Adult Education); Diploma of Professional Retraining in Practical Epigenetics (1,100 hours); Continuing Professional Education Certificate in Epigenetics, Immanuel Kant Baltic Federal University; Certificate in Sports Nutrition and Nutritional Science; Coach-Practitioner Diploma aligned with ICF standards; advanced training in Biological Energy; First Aid course.

## Services

- [Services and pricing](https://epigenetic-rejuvenation.com/#uslugi): four paid programs, price on request
  - Basic Epigenetic Rejuvenation Program: personalized lifestyle recommendations, easy exercises, gradual nutrition corrections, 1 month of support, precision smart scale as a bonus
  - Profi Epigenetic Rejuvenation Program: everything in Basic plus a measurement-based program, blood test interpretation by a preventive medicine physician, Epigenetic Age Reversal Protocol and a personal Epigenetic Rejuvenation Tracker
  - VIP Epigenetic Rejuvenation Program: everything in Profi plus advanced nutrition and activity plans, 2 months of supervision with 6 consultations, executive wellness mentoring
  - Intensive course on a paradise island "Immersion into Youth": everything in VIP plus a one-week in-person retreat with private lessons, Eastern energy practices, accommodation, flights, meals and training
- Consultation stages: diagnostics (questionnaire, smart scale measurement), recommendations prepared in 2 to 5 days, answers to questions, supervision until the result

## Methodology

- [Methodology](https://epigenetic-rejuvenation.com/#metodika): based on self-care and balance of body, emotions and mind. Practical core: adding tasty healthy foods, enjoyable physical activity, healthy sleep, superfoods, beneficial habits, emotional intelligence. Changes are chosen to be comfortable and pleasant ("active hedonistic longevity").
- Science context: epigenetics studies how lifestyle switches genes on and off; DNA methylation clocks such as GrimAge estimate biological ageing; research by scientists like David Sinclair (Harvard Medical School) suggests ageing can be slowed and partly reversed.
